Happy Thanksgiving!

We're kicking off Thanksgiving Reconnect Weekend with our Turkey Vulture Trot 5k and 1-Mile Fun Run today at 9am, followed by a full Thanksgiving Buffet at the Wild Tomato from 11am to 5pm. On Friday, join us in welcoming the holiday season with the First Light and Holiday Trail Celebration at 5pm.

After two nights of successful snowmaking on Monday and Tuesday, our Mountain Operations team is anticipating more opportunities with favorable conditions to build on our base of snow ahead of Crystal Mountain's 70th season. Stay tuned to our Mountain Report for official updates on Opening Day!

Our 70th Anniversary Season is one you won't want to miss!
